notes.title: Demo version update
notes.content:
Friends!

On December 20, 2024, a small update of the demo version is coming.

Among the changes, in addition to minor fixes:

[list]
[*] Level map functionality 
[*] Mini-bosses now have their own mini-health bars.
[*] Some new secrets and a new secret weapon were added.
[*] The tutorial has been somewhat simplified.
[*] Free and endless healing point  was added just before the final boss. 
[*] Some optimization has been made (not very critical, though).
[*] Potentially - steaming hot, fresh bugs.
[/list]

Bad news: unfortunately, old saves will not be compatible with the updated version. 
OK news:  the branch with the previous version and old saves support will still be available (TriznaDemo1.0).
